The framework

Vestibular maturity model.

Each stage maps a diagnostic state to a client package and AI augmentation layer.

Prices shown include GST. Fixed-fee engagements — nothing is billed hourly. Scope, deliverables and exclusions are agreed in writing before any work starts.

Stage 1: Foundational

  • Diagnostic lens: Chaotic → tool sprawl, unclear workflows, burnout signals.
  • Focus: Restore clarity, reduce cognitive load, establish hygiene.
  • Outcomes: Reduced clutter, clear workflows, initial alignment.
  • Deliverables: Tool hygiene audit, sanitation playbook.
  • Package: Declutter.
  • AI augmentation: Automated Jira board cleanup, duplicate detection, backlog hygiene assistant.
